author: nemi
text: Okay, let's hear the sandwich out. It's got layers, it's well prepared, and it hasn't agreed to do anything embarrassing today. Honestly, it should be wearing my badge. Unfortunately, I can't send bread through that door and go home, so three gets the badge. We'll keep the sandwich as an emergency understudy.
